class.name: DialogueAsset
class.brief_description: A dialogue resource that allows easy creation and management of [DialogueLocalization] or [Dialogue] resources in the editor.
class.description:
The [DialogueAsset] resource is used when creating dialogue resources in the editor. This resource can create and manage either [DialogueLocalization] resources or regular [Dialogues] resources depending on whether multilingual support is needed.
You can set whether to support multiple languages through the [member is_locale] value.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member: Specifies whether to set this dialogue resource as a [DialogueLocalization] resource for multilingual support. When set to true, it operates as a [DialogueLocalization] resource; when set to false, it operates as a [Dialogues] resource.
